title: Future Marriage: Choosing a Partner, Rights, and Building a Family
summary: At the age of 13-15, thinking about marriage begins. Do not start the discussion too early, but do not delay it either: choose a partner based on deen (religion) and akhlaq (character). Learn about mutual rights (nafaqah (maintenance), mawaddah (affection), sakinah (tranquility)), and start building skills now: dialogue, tolerance, and bearing responsibility.
try_this: This week: Discuss together a scenario: "If you were to choose your life partner, what are the 3 most important qualities you would look for?" Listen together without judgment, and guide them toward the Shar'i (legal Islamic) criteria.
reflection_prompts: What qualities did your son mention?
Did they understand the difference between hubb (love) and shahwah (desire)?
